# airs model-security

```text
AI Model Security operations — groups, rules, scans

Usage: airs model-security [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  groups          Manage security groups
  install         Install the model-security-client Python package from AIRS PyPI
  labels          Manage scan labels
  models          Browse the scanned model catalog (read-only)
  pypi-auth       Get PyPI authentication URL for Google Artifact Registry
  rule-instances  Manage rule instances in groups
  rules           Browse security rules

      --debug            Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --tenant <name>    Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
  -h, --help             Print help
```

```text
      --dry-run          Print the commands without executing

  -h, --help             Print help
```
